messages:
Maya Patel: Ok team — we're launching the SI Trainer Accelerator in Q2. Need a sprint plan for trainer onboarding and partner enablement. Target: certify 8 trainers, onboard 3 integrators into the marketplace, and have HW validation done for 2 partner hardware configs. Who volunteers to own curriculum, exam, and the lab infra?

Tom Nguyen: I can own lab infra and validation images. Need model list + expected seq lengths and latency SLOs. Will prepare a reproducible docker image for the labs.

Jess Carter: I'll own curriculum and the certification rubric. My initial idea: 3-day core workshop (fundamentals + deployment patterns) + 1 week of shadowing on live customer flows, then a practitioner exam that includes a recorded demo + repo submission. Badge awarded after passing demo + repo review.

Ravi Singh: I'll coordinate partner ops and pilot integrators (AccelSoft, CloudIntegrate, SystemsCo). Need an NDA/MSA checklist and a marketplace listing readiness doc. Also want a repeatable kickoff agenda.

onboarding-bot: Marketplace listing template v2 uploaded: https://redwood.docs/marketplace/template-v2 (reminder: use the new image naming scheme)

Maya Patel: Sounds good. Question: proctored exam or self-proctored? We should balance rigor with partner velocity.

Jess Carter: Leaning self-proctored + two required live proctored demos for integrators we plan to recommend to customers. Self-proctored is repo + recorded demo with timestamped checklist; proctored demo uses Zoom recording + consent form. I'll draft rubric and checklist by EOD Friday.

Tom Nguyen: For lab infra, here's a minimal compose snippet for trainer VMs (will add to infra repo):

```yaml
version: '3.7'
services:
  redwood-lab:
    image: ghcr.io/redwood/lab-base:2026-04
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              count: all
    environment:
      - MODEL_SET=instruction-tiny,chat-medium,embed-large
      - SEQ_TARGET=1024
    volumes:
      - ./kv-cache:/kv-cache
```

Tom Nguyen: Also will publish an infra checklist for driver/kernel versions and an NVLink test script.

Samir Rao: From the SI side: can we include a hardware validation checklist that covers GPU firmware, driver, and network perf? Our ops teams need clear pass/fail gates before marketplace listing.

Jess Carter: Yes — will add a "HW validation" section to the rubric: required kernel/driver ranges, perf runs (p95 latency targets), and a small quantization sanity test. Will also include a template CSV for results submission.

Maya Patel: Great. Action items: Jess -> certification rubric + exam format (due Fri), Tom -> lab image + infra checklist (due Wed), Ravi -> NDA/MSA + partner kickoff invites (due Tue). I'll own the marketplace readiness checklist and the trainer cohort schedule.

Ravi Singh: I'll schedule kickoff calls with the three pilot SIs for next Wednesday.

Maya Patel: Perfect. Quick note: include a 30-minute weekly office hours for trainer Q&A during the accelerator (:calendar: weekly, first session Mon). Also include a short feedback form after each workshop day.

Jess Carter: On it. I'll draft feedback form and a short trainer playbook (one-pager) that trainers can hand to partners.

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone :white_check_mark: We'll sync again after docs are up.
